All three solutions use the same correct system of equations:

\[
\begin{cases}
L + D + B = 43\\
L = D + 7\\
D = \tfrac12 B\;( \text{so } B = 2D)
\end{cases}
\]

Substituting \(L = D+7\) and \(B = 2D\) into the total gives  

\[
(D+7) + D + 2D = 43 \;\Longrightarrow\; 4D + 7 = 43 \;\Longrightarrow\; D = 9.
\]

Then  

\[
L = D + 7 = 9 + 7 = 16.
\]

The numbers satisfy the original conditions (Lily = 16, David = 9, Bodhi = 18, total = 43). Therefore the answer is correct.

**Final answer:** 16
